item.title: Woman dead, 2 people hospitalized in wrong-way Whiteford Township crash
item.description: One woman is dead, and two people have been hospitalized after a wrong-way crash on US-23 in Whiteford Township on Saturday evening, according to the Monroe County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Thousands compete in massive President's Day volleyball tournament at Huntington Place
item.description: Thousands of volleyball players from across the U.S. and Canada descended on Detroit's Huntington Place this weekend for the ninth annual President's Day Challenge.

item.title: Historic Detroit mosque celebrates intersection of Black History Month and Ramadan
item.description: On Detroit's west side, Masjid Wali Muhammad stands as more than just a place of worship; it represents nearly 70 years of Muslim African American history
